title: WRRA-M 0.6: Information Load and Twist Gravity with Expansion in a Finite Model
description:
WRRA-M 0.6 completes a finite homogeneous constitutive model connecting positive information-state loads to twist, pressure and expansion through one energy functional and classical homogeneous action. A declared unitary state update conserves total energy with volume work and permits cancelling internal exchange between two load sectors. The same clustering load enters the inherited calibrated local rotation and conditional lensing response, reproducing corrected 0.5 outputs. A chosen finite boundaryless T3 construction relates energy and twist records without identifying actual cosmic topology or length. Energy homogeneity exponents, load operators and information clock remain disclosed constitutive choices. A unique microscopic origin, four-dimensional covariant local completion and spatial perturbation stability remain open. The symmetric sixteen-channel carrier retains zero filter-selection gaps. Korean and English manuscripts, code and independent numerical checks are provided.

한국어와 영문 원고는 같은 수식과 수치 장부를 사용한다. 상태별 부하에서 압력·동역학까지 계산한 유한 동질 구성 모형이며 국소 응답은 기존 보정값의 조건부 연결이다.

Series correction r1 supplies revised bilingual 0.1–0.4 manuscripts: real-to-complex representation and independent Weyl-channel assumptions, eta > 0 and initial support for convergence, legitimate calibration provenance, public exact 0.1–0.3 checks over 6,561 tables, and directly computed rank 16 in 0.4. Existing 0.5 and 0.6 results are retained.

Revision 0.6-r2 applies the 0.6 lattice_N to both state loads and transport tests, preserves the original calibration input, and passes 64/128 and 128/64 cross-grid regressions. Global twist record magnitude is an instantaneous load-density and spatial-size aggregate, with no independent temporal accumulation law. The adopted reference values remain q0=-0.52855, v=207.510905 km/s and conditional deflection=0.535586511 arcsec.

0.6-r2는 격자 입력을 연결하고 전역 뒤틀림 기록의 크기라는 용어와 순간 집계 정의를 한영 원고·그림에 반영한다. 기준 계산 결과와 0.1~0.5의 원고를 유지한다.
